info.title: Tezos Systems Public Data
info.description: Read-only Tezos Systems metadata, generated research artifacts, and public browser datasets. Artifact fields disclose their own sources and observation times where applicable.

get.summary: Get served build metadata
get.description: Current committed build stamp and latest user-facing change used by the site footer and update transmission.
get.x-refresh-cadence: Every normal commit
get.x-license-boundary: Repository-authored metadata is covered by MPL-2.0.

get.summary: Get the curated Tezos protocol history
get.description: Protocol chronology, upgrade changes, debates, and source links.
get.x-refresh-cadence: When an accepted protocol or curated history changes
get.x-license-boundary: Original selection, arrangement, and commentary are CC BY 4.0 where owned; underlying facts and linked sources retain their source terms.
